scope: Official competitor application notes and technical notes showing applied LC, LC-MS, LC-MS/MS, and informatics workflows. Dates use the exact publication date where available and month or year precision where the official source provides only that level of detail.

notes.title: Direct Injection LC-MS/MS Quantification of C1-C4 Ultrashort-Chain PFAS in Drinking Water
notes.products: Vanquish Duo UHPLC and TSQ Altis Plus EFOX Edition
notes.evidenceStatement: Thermo Fisher demonstrates a regulation-ready workflow for ultrashort-chain PFAS that conventional reversed-phase methods struggle to retain.

notes.title: Routine Application of EPA Method 1633A to Environmental Samples Using the novus V55 System
notes.evidenceStatement: SCIEX demonstrates EPA Method 1633A across non-potable water, solids, biosolids and biological tissues on its compact triple-quadrupole platform.

notes.title: Enhanced Data Quality in LC-MS/MS Analysis of Nitrosamines
notes.products: InfinityLab Quick Change solvent purifier and Agilent LC/MS/MS
notes.evidenceStatement: Agilent demonstrates an LC-MS/MS workflow intended to improve data quality for regulated nitrosamine impurity analysis.

notes.title: Narrow-Window Scanning DIA for Unbiased Label-Free Quantitation
notes.evidenceStatement: SCIEX demonstrates narrower precursor isolation to improve protein-group ratio accuracy and quantitative proteomics performance.

notes.title: Robust, High-Throughput Peptide Quantitation
notes.products: TSQ Certis triple quadrupole MS and OptiSpray
notes.evidenceStatement: Thermo Fisher promotes robustness and high throughput for quantitative peptide workflows on its triple-quadrupole platform.

notes.title: Quantitative Analysis of QACs in Milk Using a QuEChERS Sample Preparation Approach
notes.evidenceStatement: Shimadzu demonstrates a low-ng/mL LC-MS/MS method for nine quaternary ammonium compounds with minimal sample preparation.

notes.title: Confirmation of Intact Protein Molecular Weight Using a Single Quadrupole Mass Spectrometer
notes.products: Nexera X3, LCMS-2050 and LabSolutions Insight Biologics
notes.evidenceStatement: Shimadzu positions a single-quadrupole LC-MS plus deconvolution software as a simpler quality-control route for intact proteins.

notes.title: Drug Metabolite Identification with a Streamlined Software Workflow
notes.products: Revident LC/Q-TOF, MassHunter Explorer and BioTransformer
notes.evidenceStatement: Agilent packages drug-metabolite identification as a streamlined instrument-and-software workflow.

notes.title: ZT Scan DIA 3.0 Metabolomics Analysis
notes.evidenceStatement: SCIEX demonstrates reduced chimeric spectral overlap to improve metabolome coverage and quantitative analysis.

notes.title: A Fast and Ultra-Sensitive Method for Analysis of TFA in Multiple Water Sources
notes.products: SCIEX LC-MS/MS with Shimadzu LC-40 and PFAS kit
notes.evidenceStatement: SCIEX addresses the emerging ultrashort-chain PFAS challenge with a dedicated TFA method for multiple water matrices.

notes.title: Pesticide Screening with Fast Polarity Switching Using Agilent Revident LC/Q-TOF
notes.evidenceStatement: Agilent demonstrates screening of more than 200 pesticides in a complex food matrix while positioning fast polarity switching as a throughput advantage.

notes.title: Automated LC/MS Quality Control of Anti-Sense Oligonucleotides
notes.products: InfinityLab Pro iQ Plus, OpenLab CDS and Oligo Analysis Accelerator
notes.evidenceStatement: Agilent presents ASO purity assessment as an automated LC/MS quality-control workflow with purpose-built software.

notes.title: Determination of 30 PFAS in Seafood by LC-MS/MS
notes.evidenceStatement: Shimadzu extends PFAS workflow proof from water into seafood matrices with a 30-analyte LC-MS/MS method.

notes.title: An Integrated LC-MS System Performance Evaluation Test for Oligonucleotide Analysis
notes.products: Vanquish UHPLC, Orbitrap Exploris and Chromeleon eWorkflow
notes.evidenceStatement: Thermo Fisher defines pass/fail criteria for oligonucleotide LC-MS performance and packages acquisition, processing and reporting into a deployable workflow.

refreshContract.completenessDefinition: All registered or discovered official records are retained. No current adapter represents a complete vendor application-note inventory.

analysisBoundary.reason: Vendor application-note libraries are not collected comprehensively or with equivalent discovery methods.
analysisBoundary.allowedUse: Group and inspect observed workflows; do not rank themes, compare publisher volume, or infer market demand from record counts.
